patch_list: Disables Adobe Experience Platform MobileCore, EventHub, Adobe Growth SDK (DGP/MAU and Dunamis), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Creative SDK, Branch attribution, Facebook App Events and Audience Network, Firebase Performance, Firebase Sess…
Names new scans 'Scan on [date]' instead of 'Adobe Scan [date]' and removes the attribution text from shared files.
Starts Adobe Scan in its existing account-free local workspace and removes account sign-in gates; Adobe cloud features are unavailable.
Removes promotional, feedback, and support items from Settings and file menus.
Enables locally executable premium OCR, editing, compression, and page-organization tools without cloud or GenAI access.
Overrides Adobe Clean fonts across XML layouts, dialogs, and Jetpack Compose screens with the device's system font.
